messages:
Alex: Heads-up — hit a repro in the sample-payments app where retries on 429s cause duplicate charges. Found it while testing token refresh + bursty traffic.
Mira: ouch. is this the SDK or the sample app logic?
Alex: looks like a mix. JS SDK default retries differ from Python (JS was retrying idempotent POSTs w/o idempotency key). sample app also retries at the HTTP layer blindly.
Jamal: can you paste logs? especially headers like `Idempotency-Key` and `Retry-After` if present
Alex: logs: 
```
POST /v1/charge 429 Retry-After: 1
body: { amount: 100 }
headers: { Authorization: Bearer x, Idempotency-Key: null }
```
No idempotency header, app tried again after 1s and got 200 on second attempt (duplicate).
Priya: hmm. SDK should never retry non-idempotent writes by default. We agreed on that in the spec. Looks like parity bug.
Mira: which versions?
Alex: js-sdk@0.9.1 and py-sdk@0.11.0 — py has idempotency-by-default for `create_charge` helper, js does not.
Jamal: ok actionable: 1) make JS follow Python semantics (require explicit idempotency header or SDK helper auto-generate for high-level methods) 2) update sample app to surface idempotency key usage in quickstart 3) add a lint/test to catch blind HTTP-layer retries.
Priya: also consider default backoff strategy. what are current defaults?
Mira: py: 3 retries, exponential backoff base 300ms, max 5s, full jitter. js: 5 retries, linear jitter-ish, base 200ms, no idempotency check.
Alex: propose unify to: 3 retries for 429/5xx, base 500ms, exp backoff factor 2, max 10s, full jitter. and crucial: never retry unsafe methods (POST/PUT/PATCH) unless `Idempotency-Key` present or method-level helper signals idempotent intent.
Jamal: agree. add special-case for `401` if token refresh is in-flight: short retry (1 attempt after refresh) because some auth servers briefly reject with 401 during rotation.
Priya: for UX, we should surface a warning in console when SDK auto-generates idempotency keys (so devs know): `Idempotency-Key: auto-generated (see docs)`.
Mira: sample app changes: show how to set `Idempotency-Key` in the request shim and how to get deterministic replay in tests. Also update quickstart README with recommended backoff config snippet.
Alex: added a small repro gist in thread: 
```
// JS SDK snippet
await client.charges.create({ amount: 100 }, { idempotencyKey: uuid() });
// fallback: if not provided, SDK should not retry automatically for POST
```
Jamal: also recommend exposing a `shouldRetry(err, request)` hook in SDKs so apps can opt-in custom logic instead of swapping SDK internals.
Priya: can we include a small e2e in CI that simulates 429 followed by success and verifies no duplicate resources created? even a smoke test for payments flow.
Mira: yes — add a test that flips a mock endpoint: respond 429 once, then 200, assert server only processed once (server can track idempotency-key).
Alex: I'll open a PR for the sample app and JS SDK parity patch. PR will: 
- change JS default retry behavior
- add telemetry log when idempotency auto-generated
- update docs/quickstart
- add CI e2e test (mock)
Mira: tagging eng-runtime for visibility? this affects serving semantics and the `Retry-After` honor behavior. @CLI Bot: deploy hooks?
CLI Bot: noted — will open a runtime-compat check ticket. :spiral_note_pad: #TICKET-3421
API Monitor: detected increased 429s from test cluster last night between 02:10-02:45 UTC — likely related to load test.
Jamal: cool. owners: Alex (sample app + docs), Mira (tests + SDK spec), Priya (telemetry + release notes). I'll shepherd the runtime ticket with CLI Bot.
Alex: thanks — will ping here when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
